mujoco_solver_parameters.zh: MuJoCo 4.0 求解参数与摩擦约束
mujoco_solver_parameters.en: MuJoCo 4.0 solver parameters and friction constraints

mujoco_contact_parameters.zh: MuJoCo 4.0 接触参数组合规则

mujoco_contact_distances.zh: MuJoCo 接触检测与施力距离
mujoco_contact_distances.en: MuJoCo contact detection and force thresholds

mujoco_contact_distance_migration.zh: MuJoCo 3.9 接触距离参数迁移

dexlab_failure.zh: DexLab：当我们在讨论 Sim-to-Real Gap 时
dexlab_failure.en: DexLab: What do we mean by the Sim-to-Real Gap?

name.zh: 接触求解收敛了，滑块为什么还会离开桌面？
name.en: Why can a converged contact solver lift a block off the table?

summary.zh: 用同一个解析滑块解释凸松弛的抬离和固定正则化的慢滑，定位接触定律与求解误差各自的证据。
summary.en: Use a single analytical block to explain lift-off and creep, and identify the evidence for contact-law effects and solver error.

name.zh: NeuralActuator：执行器误差要单独建模，接触仍要交给物理
name.en: NeuralActuator: model actuator error separately; keep contact in physics

summary.zh: 先证明命令、状态、telemetry 与力参考能区分执行器误差和接触载荷，再谈学习型 torque surrogate。
summary.en: First show that command, state, telemetry and force references separate actuator error from contact load; then consider a learned torque surrogate.

name.zh: 当我们在讨论仿真 Sim-to-Real Gap 问题时，我们在讨论什么？
name.en: What do we mean when we discuss the Sim-to-Real Gap?

summary.zh: Sim-to-Real Gap 不是单一误差或引擎排名，而是一条从任务、参数、动力学和观测一直延伸到真机验证的证据链。
summary.en: The Sim-to-Real Gap is not a single error or engine ranking; it is an evidence chain from task and parameters through dynamics and observation to hardware validation.

body.zh: 这篇研究总论把现有实验重新组织为七层判断，并明确没有真机数据时能够证明什么、不能证明什么。
body.en: This research synthesis reorganizes existing experiments into seven layers and states what can and cannot be established without hardware data.

example.zh: 一个看似 solver 失败的面包滑脱，可能先由浅抓取几何造成，再由抬升加速度放大。
example.en: An apparent solver-driven bread drop may begin with shallow grasp geometry and then be amplified by lift acceleration.

zh: 仿真内部通过、视觉相似和任务成功都不等于 sim-to-real 验证。
en: Simulation-internal passes, visual similarity and task success do not establish sim-to-real validation.

name.zh: 当我们在讨论灵巧操作仿真时，我们在讨论什么？
name.en: What do we mean when we discuss dexterous simulation?

summary.zh: 从任务、本体、物理、传感、策略和验证六层理解灵巧操作仿真。
summary.en: A six-layer guide to tasks, embodiment, physics, sensing, policy and validation in dexterous simulation.

name.zh: LIBERO：从原生任务到可验证的改进
name.en: LIBERO: from a native task to a verifiable change

summary.zh: 区分原任务成功、观测刷新、接触诊断和数值敏感性。
summary.en: Separate native task success, observation refresh, contact diagnostics and numerical sensitivity.

name.zh: Code as Policy：从“模型写代码”到可验证的机器人技能
name.en: Code as Policy: from model-written programs to verified robot skills

summary.zh: 把任务语义、反馈、动作顺序和失败恢复写成可检查、可修改的程序。
summary.en: Represent task meaning, feedback, action order and recovery as inspectable programs.

name.zh: 多求解器如何同步？preCICE 做什么？
name.en: How do solvers synchronize, and what does preCICE do?

summary.zh: 分开墙钟时间、仿真时间、内部步长和跨求解器交换周期。
summary.en: Separate wall time, simulation time, substeps and cross-solver exchange periods.

name.zh: 物理 caption 怎样进入 DexLab：先评参考覆盖，再查视频事实
name.en: Physical captions in DexLab: measure reference coverage before claiming video truth

summary.zh: 在比较物理描述前，先确认参考记录是否覆盖对象、接触、因果和时间顺序。
summary.en: Before comparing physical captions, check reference coverage of objects, contact, causality and temporal order.

name.zh: 视觉目标 mask 怎样进入 DexLab：先证明它是进度信号，再谈 GCRL
name.en: Visual goal masks in DexLab: prove the progress signal before training GCRL

summary.zh: 目标 mask 进入策略或奖励前，必须先通过单调性、遮挡和误检检查。
summary.en: Before a target mask enters a policy or reward, test monotonicity, occlusion and false detections.

name.zh: DONIC 的双手跟踪分，能看出交接成功吗？
name.en: Can a DONIC tracking score tell whether a handoff succeeded?

summary.zh: 用杯子交接解释参考跟踪、实际接触与阶段任务结果各需要什么证据。
summary.en: A cup handoff shows what evidence is needed for reference tracking, contact, and the phase outcome.

name.zh: RoboAgentLab：怎样让机器人 Agent 的动作和结果对得上？
name.en: RoboAgentLab: can you trace an agent's command to the robot's outcome?

summary.zh: 用 HumanCLAW 沙发回放说明动作请求、原生指标和任务验收为何需要分别留证。
summary.en: A HumanCLAW couch replay shows why an action request, a native metric, and physical task acceptance each need evidence.

name.zh: PhysicsNeMo：位置预测准了，接触事件也准吗？
name.en: PhysicsNeMo: does accurate position prediction get contact events right?

summary.zh: 用车壳穿越和握球卸载说明：动作输入、接触事件和探针覆盖要分别验证。
summary.en: Shell crossings and finger unloading show why action inputs, contact events, and probe coverage need separate checks.

name.zh: 布料：同一场景，不同引擎

summary.zh: 分别验收形变、下垂、穿透、残余运动和成本，不把它们混成一个引擎分数。
summary.en: Score deformation, sag, penetration, residual motion and cost separately instead of collapsing them into one engine score.

name.zh: 仿真里，怎么知道豆腐和香蕉真的切开了？
name.en: How can we tell if a simulated cut fully separates tofu or banana?

summary.zh: 用刀面侧推最后一块，检查它能否单独移动，以及切缝两边是否仍相连。
summary.en: Push the last piece sideways with the blade and check whether it moves on its own and whether the two sides are still connected.

summary.zh: 状态是仿真在某一时刻保存的位置、速度及必要内部量。
summary.en: State is the position, velocity and required internal quantities at one simulation instant.

body.zh: 同样的关节角不一定意味着同样的动力学未来；速度、执行器状态、接触历史和 reset 方式也可能改变下一步。
body.en: The same joint angles do not imply the same dynamic future; velocity, actuator state, contact history and reset semantics can also change the next step.

example.zh: 闭链脚踝只写脚踝角、不同时恢复电机角，会让杆长不一致并产生校正力。
example.en: Writing only the ankle angle without restoring motor angles can make rod lengths inconsistent and create corrective forces.

zh: 状态不等于观测；观测可能只暴露状态的一部分。
en: State is not observation; an observation may expose only part of the state.

summary.zh: 仿真时间由物理步数乘步长推进，不是墙钟时间。
summary.en: Simulation time advances by physics-step count times timestep, not by wall-clock time.

body.zh: 一段记录是否覆盖完整任务，要看仿真时钟、采样时刻和步数，而不是视频时长。
body.en: Whether a record covers the whole task depends on simulation clock, sample epoch and step count, not video duration.

example.zh: 两段同样 6 秒的视频可能分别以 2 ms 和 4 ms 推进，采样与接触事件数量不同。
example.en: Two six-second videos may step at 2 ms and 4 ms, producing different samples and contact events.

zh: 视频播放速度不是仿真速度，渲染帧率也不是物理步频。
en: Playback speed is not simulation speed, and render frame rate is not physics rate.

summary.zh: 步长是积分器每次从当前状态推进到的仿真时间间隔。
summary.en: A timestep is the simulation interval advanced by one integration step.

body.zh: 步长同时影响离散误差、稳定性、接触采样次数和计算成本；更小不保证结果更接近真实材料。
body.en: Timestep changes discretization error, stability, contact sampling and cost; a smaller value does not guarantee greater physical accuracy.

example.zh: LIBERO 从 2 ms 改到 1 ms 后，物理诊断从 5/10 降到 3/10，原生步进成本约翻倍。
example.en: Changing LIBERO from 2 ms to 1 ms reduced physical diagnostics from 5/10 to 3/10 while nearly doubling native stepping cost.

zh: 步长不是精度等级；它必须与接触参数、求解器、执行器和控制周期一起读。
en: Timestep is not a precision tier; read it with contact parameters, solver, actuators and control period.

summary.zh: 一个外层控制或交换周期内可以连续执行多个物理子步。
summary.en: An outer control or exchange period may contain several internal physics substeps.

body.zh: 内部多做子步不等于跨求解器交换次数增加；时序必须分别记录。
body.en: More internal substeps do not automatically increase cross-solver exchanges; record the clocks separately.

example.zh: 50 Hz 控制周期内执行十次 2 ms 物理步，控制仍是 50 Hz。
example.en: Ten 2 ms physics steps fit inside one 50 Hz control period; the controller still updates at 50 Hz.

zh: substeps 不是控制频率，也不是墙钟帧率。
en: Substeps are neither control frequency nor wall-clock frame rate.

summary.zh: 控制周期是控制器两次发出新命令之间的仿真时间。
summary.en: The control period is the simulated-time interval between new controller commands.

body.zh: 物理步可以更细，但命令会在控制周期内保持或按实现插值。
body.en: Physics may step more finely while a command is held or interpolated over the control period.

example.zh: 20 ms 的控制周期内可以发生接触建立、承载或丢失，而策略直到周期结束才看到新观测。
example.en: Contact may form, carry or disappear within a 20 ms control period before the policy sees a new observation.

zh: 控制周期不是求解器步长，渲染周期也不决定控制时刻。
en: Control period is not solver timestep, and render cadence does not determine command timing.

summary.zh: 坐标系规定位置、方向、速度和力相对谁表达。
summary.en: A coordinate frame defines what positions, orientations, velocities and forces are expressed relative to.

body.zh: 同一个量换坐标系后符号和分量可能变化，物理结论不应因此改变。
body.en: Components and signs can change with the frame even though the underlying physical claim should not.

example.zh: 自由关节角速度必须按 MuJoCo 约定从物体系转到世界系，才能正确计算角动量。
example.en: MuJoCo free-joint angular velocity must be rotated from body to world frame before checking angular momentum.

zh: 数值相同不代表坐标系相同；先核对 frame，再比较向量。
en: Equal numbers do not imply equal frames; verify the frame before comparing vectors.

summary.zh: 速度描述状态位置随时间变化的瞬时率。
summary.en: Velocity describes the instantaneous rate at which state position changes in time.

body.zh: 位置看起来不动仍可能有非零速度；采样时刻和积分前后语义会改变读数。
body.en: Positions can look stationary while velocity is nonzero; sample epoch and pre/post-integration semantics change the reading.

example.zh: PhysX pinch 记录中位置几乎不变，但上报速度仍非零，需要先核查状态与积分时刻。
example.en: A PhysX pinch record showed almost unchanged position with nonzero reported velocity, requiring a state/integration-epoch audit first.

zh: 位置差分速度、积分器速度和传感器速度可能有不同时间含义。
en: Differenced position, integrator velocity and sensor velocity can carry different epochs.

summary.zh: 加速度描述速度随时间的变化率。
summary.en: Acceleration describes how velocity changes in time.

body.zh: `discrete` 积分器下的 `qacc` 可能表示一步速度差除以步长，而不是连续时间加速度。
body.en: Under the discrete integrator, qacc may be a velocity difference over one step rather than continuous-time acceleration.

example.zh: 同一状态在 4 ms 和 2 ms 下可能有不同的 qacc 数值，即使连续物理解释相同。
example.en: The same state can produce different qacc values at 4 ms and 2 ms even when the continuous interpretation matches.

zh: 积分器字段名相同，不代表所有积分器拥有相同时间语义。
en: A shared field name does not give every integrator the same time semantics.

summary.zh: 自由度是独立描述系统运动的坐标维数。
summary.en: Degrees of freedom are the independent dimensions needed to describe system motion.

body.zh: 关节位置维数 nq 不一定等于速度维数 nv，四元数自由关节就是常见例子。
body.en: Position dimension nq need not equal velocity dimension nv, as in free joints represented by quaternions.

example.zh: 把 qpos 与 qvel 当成一一对应会让四元数自由体速度映射出错。
example.en: Treating qpos and qvel as one-to-one breaks velocity mapping for quaternion free bodies.

zh: 关节数量、DOF 数和 qpos 长度不是同一计数。
en: Joint count, DOF count and qpos length are not the same count.

summary.zh: 接触是几何表面接近到足以交换法向或切向作用力的状态。
summary.en: Contact is a geometric state in which surfaces are close enough to exchange normal or tangential forces.

body.zh: 接触检测提出候选，接触模型决定响应，求解器再与其他约束共同求力。
body.en: Collision detection proposes candidates, the contact model defines response, and the solver resolves them with other constraints.

example.zh: 手指有接触读数不代表能承重；还要检查持续接触、力方向、支撑对象和物体运动。
example.en: A contact reading does not prove load support; check persistent contact, force direction, support owner and object motion.

zh: 接触存在不等于摩擦足够，也不等于任务成功。
en: Contact existence does not imply enough friction or task success.

summary.zh: MuJoCo 接触允许的力和力矩分量。夹住还会扭、球滚个不停、物体沿面滑动，先分清是哪种相对运动。
summary.en: The forces and torques a MuJoCo contact can transmit. Distinguish twisting in a grasp, persistent rolling and sliding along a surface.

body.zh: 用 `condim` 选接触可以阻碍哪些运动，用 `friction` 决定这些方向上的摩擦能力。先读实际接触的 `dim`，再决定改哪个。
body.en: Use `condim` to choose which motions the contact can oppose and `friction` to set the capacity in those directions. Read the actual contact's `dim` before changing either.

example.zh: 夹持小球时，若它沿指腹下滑，先查切向载荷和滑动摩擦。若它主要绕指腹法向自转，检查是否需要 `condim=4` 及对应扭转系数。
example.en: If a pinched ball slides down the pads, check tangential load and sliding friction. If it mostly spins about the pad normal, check whether `condim=4` and a torsional coefficient are appropriate.

zh: 接触点上的内禀扭转力矩与接触力通过力臂产生的力矩需要分别计算。
en: A torque intrinsic to a contact and a torque generated by a contact force through a lever arm are distinct contributions.

summary.zh: MuJoCo 3.9 起，margin 设定普通接触何时开始施力。物体还没碰到就被顶开，先核对它。
summary.en: Since MuJoCo 3.9, margin sets the activation distance for ordinary contact forces. Check it when an object is pushed back before touching.

body.zh: 普通接触中，`dist` 为正表示碰撞几何之间还有距离。正 `margin` 会让接触在几何表面尚未相交时就有机会施力。
body.en: In ordinary contact, positive `dist` means the collision surfaces are still apart. A positive `margin` lets contact forces act while those surfaces are still separated.

example.zh: 球离桌面 2 mm，实际 `includemargin` 是 3 mm，已进入施力区。若读到正法向力，接着检查这个提前量是否是任务需要的。
example.en: A ball 2 mm above a plane with an effective `includemargin` of 3 mm is in the force region. If the normal force is positive, check whether the task calls for that early response.

zh: 渲染表面可能与碰撞几何不同。先用 `dist` 和法向力确认真的发生了提前施力。
en: Rendered surfaces may differ from collision shapes. Use `dist` and the normal force to confirm actual early force activation.

summary.zh: MuJoCo 3.9 起，gap 让接触更早被检测，同时保留原来的普通接触施力距离。
summary.en: Since MuJoCo 3.9, gap extends detection while preserving the ordinary contact force threshold.

body.zh: 想在碰到之前就让控制器知道两物体靠近，可增加 `gap`。想让普通接触更早推回物体，查 [`margin`](margin.md)。
body.en: Increase `gap` when a controller needs to know that two bodies are approaching. Check [`margin`](margin.md) if ordinary contact should push the bodies back sooner.

example.zh: 球还离桌面 5 mm，接触对的 `margin` 是 3 mm、`gap` 是 4 mm。球进入 7 mm 检测区，因此可以有接触记录，而普通接触法向力仍为零。
example.en: A ball is 5 mm above a plane with a pair `margin` of 3 mm and `gap` of 4 mm. It is inside the 7 mm detection region, so it can have a contact record with zero ordinary normal force.

zh: 正 `ncon` 只表示有记录。检查目标接触自己的 `efc_address`、`dist` 和 `includemargin`。
en: A positive `ncon` counts records. Inspect `efc_address`, `dist` and `includemargin` on the target contact itself.

summary.zh: 改了某个 geom 的参数却没效果时，先检查两侧最终合成出的接触参数。
summary.en: When editing one geom seems to do nothing, check the effective contact parameters produced from both sides.

body.zh: 对自动生成的 geom 接触，较高 `priority` 的一侧决定 `condim`、`friction`、`solref` 和 `solimp`。同优先级时，`condim` 取较大值，摩擦逐项取较大值，`solref` 和 `solimp` 按 `solmix` 加权。任一侧的 `solref` 使用直接格式时，`solref` 逐项取较小值。
body.en: For a dynamically generated geom contact, the higher-priority side supplies `condim`, `friction`, `solref` and `solimp`. With equal `priority`, the larger `condim` and elementwise larger friction values win, while `solmix` weights `solref` and `solimp`. If either side uses direct-format `solref`, the elementwise minimum is used for `solref`.

example.zh: 同优先级时，地板滑动摩擦为 1，把箱子从 0.6 改到 0.2，实际滑动系数仍是 1。修改前后读 `contact.friction`。若只想调整这对几何，检查或显式定义 `contact/pair`，再测相同法向载荷下的滑移。
example.en: With equal priority and floor sliding friction of 1, changing a box from 0.6 to 0.2 leaves the effective coefficient at 1. Read `contact.friction` before and after. To target just that combination, check or define an explicit `contact/pair` and measure slip under the same normal load.

zh: MuJoCo 3.9 起，普通自动配对的 `margin`、`gap` 各自按两侧相加，独立于优先级与混合权重。显式 pair 使用 pair 自己的参数。
en: Since MuJoCo 3.9, ordinary dynamically paired geoms add their `margin` and `gap` separately, independent of priority and mixing weights. Explicit pairs use their own attributes.

summary.zh: 穿模是碰撞表面在记录时刻进入彼此内部或跨越表面。
summary.en: Penetration is collision geometry entering another surface or crossing it at the sampled state.

body.zh: 原生接触深度、独立表面距离、盒内距离和视频画面不是同一指标。
body.en: Native contact depth, independent surface distance, box-interior distance and visual overlap are different measurements.

example.zh: 布料场景中独立桌内侵入为 2.556627 mm 时，原生接触最大穿透只有 0.001032 mm。
example.en: A cloth case measured 2.556627 mm independent table intrusion while native contact depth was only 0.001032 mm.

zh: 非穿透需要说明是在保存帧、物理步还是连续时间内成立。
en: A non-penetration claim must state whether it covers saved frames, physics steps or continuous time.

summary.zh: 非穿模是对几何不相交范围的承诺，不是动力学正确性的总称。
summary.en: Non-penetration is a guarantee about geometric non-intersection, not a synonym for correct dynamics.

body.zh: 截断、投影或约束可以阻止穿模，却仍可能改变动量、能量或人工阻尼。
body.en: Truncation, projection or constraints may prevent penetration while still altering momentum, energy or artificial damping.

example.zh: DAT 以几何安全为核心，DexLab 仍需独立核对接触冲量、驱动功和能量收支。
example.en: DAT centers geometric safety; DexLab still needs separate contact-impulse, drive-work and energy ledgers.

zh: 不穿模不等于动量守恒，也不等于真实材料接触力准确。
en: Penetration-free does not imply momentum conservation or accurate real-material contact force.

summary.zh: 接触深度是当前接触模型沿其定义方向测得的侵入量。
summary.en: Contact depth is the intrusion measured along the direction defined by the active contact model.

body.zh: 它受几何表示、接触法向、软约束参数和采样时刻影响。
body.en: It depends on geometry representation, contact normal, soft-constraint parameters and sampling epoch.

example.zh: 同一布料三角形可同时拥有毫米级独立内部侵入和微米级原生接触深度。
example.en: The same cloth triangle can have millimetre independent intrusion and micron native contact depth.

zh: 接触深度不是物体移出碰撞所需的最小平移量。
en: Contact depth is not necessarily the minimum translation needed to separate objects.

summary.zh: 接触法向规定法向力与分离速度在几何上的正方向。
summary.en: The contact normal defines the geometric positive direction for normal force and separation velocity.

body.zh: 法向翻转会改变力的符号、摩擦平面和力矩方向。
body.en: A flipped normal changes force sign, friction plane and torque direction.

example.zh: 两个引擎都报告正力，若法向约定相反，它们可能仍在互相靠近。
example.en: Both engines can report positive force while the opposite normal convention means the bodies are still approaching.

zh: 同名 normal_force 不等于相同方向约定。
en: The same normal_force label does not guarantee the same direction convention.

summary.zh: 摩擦约束接触面之间的相对切向运动或切向趋势。
summary.en: Friction constrains relative tangential motion or its tendency at a contact.

body.zh: 摩擦系数只是模型参数；法向力、接触点、锥模型和正则化共同决定实际响应。
body.en: A friction coefficient is only a model parameter; normal force, contact points, cone model and regularization shape the response.

example.zh: 提高法向力可能让抓持更稳，但也会改变穿透、滑移和释放行为。
example.en: Increasing normal force may stabilize a grasp while also changing penetration, slip and release.

zh: 摩擦参数相同不代表接触律或材料响应等价。
en: Equal friction parameters do not imply equivalent contact laws or material response.

summary.zh: 关节限位是一个限制关节坐标进入不允许区域的双边或单边约束。
summary.en: A joint limit is a constraint that keeps a joint coordinate out of a disallowed region.

body.zh: 限位力是求解出的约束力，可能因 active set 切换呈现折点；它不是平滑驱动器输出。
body.en: Limit force is a solved constraint force and may become piecewise as the active set changes; it is not a smooth actuator output.

example.zh: G1 两个关节各自在范围内，组合姿态仍可能超出机械止挡。
example.en: Each G1 ankle joint can be in range while their combined pose lies beyond a mechanical stop.

zh: 软件关节范围不一定表示真实机构的完整可达域。
en: A software joint range need not represent the hardware reachable set.

summary.zh: 等式约束要求某个几何或传动关系在求解后保持接近目标。
summary.en: An equality constraint asks a geometric or transmission relation to remain close to its target after solving.

body.zh: 软等式仍可能有余差；约束力说明求解器在恢复该关系。
body.en: A soft equality may retain residual error; constraint force shows the solver is restoring the relation.

example.zh: 推杆闭链 reset 不一致时，等式约束会用校正力拉回杆长。
example.en: An inconsistent pushrod-loop reset makes the equality constraint pull the linkage back to its rod length.

zh: 约束存在不等于初始状态已经满足约束。
en: A constraint does not imply the initial state already satisfies it.

summary.zh: 重置把任务恢复到一个新的初始状态，并应恢复控制与约束依赖的隐藏量。
summary.en: Reset restores a task initial state and should also restore hidden quantities used by control and constraints.

body.zh: 只写部分 qpos 可能让速度、执行器、闭链或控制器历史与目标状态不一致。
body.en: Writing only part of qpos can leave velocity, actuators, closed loops or controller history inconsistent.

example.zh: 设定脚踝目标角但保留旧电机角，会使闭链在第一步产生力瞬态。
example.en: Setting an ankle target while keeping old motor angles creates a force transient in the closed chain on the first step.

zh: reset 成功返回不等于 reset 后的状态物理一致。
en: A successful reset call does not prove the resulting state is physically consistent.

summary.zh: 自碰撞是同一机器人或多体系统内部的几何接触。
summary.en: Self-collision is contact among geometry within the same robot or multibody system.

body.zh: 过滤父子邻接不等于关闭整个系统自碰撞，转换资产时要保留排除语义。
body.en: Filtering parent-child adjacency is not disabling all self-collision; preserve exclusion semantics across imports.

example.zh: 布料自穿透超过 1.5 mm 会单独导致验收失败，即使外部夹持通过。
example.en: Cloth self-penetration beyond 1.5 mm fails acceptance even when external grasping passes.

zh: 全局关闭自碰撞会改变可达域和接触结果。
en: Disabling all self-collision changes reachability and contact outcomes.

summary.zh: 支撑是某个接触或力源实际承担物体重量或外载的作用。
summary.en: Support is the physical role through which a contact or force source carries weight or another load.

body.zh: 有接触、有正法向力并不自动说明目标接触在支撑；桌面、其他手指或附件也可能承担载荷。
body.en: Contact and positive normal force do not prove the intended contact supports the load; table, other fingers or attachments may do so.

example.zh: 苹果抓取验收同时要求离桌、两片指腹持续支撑并排除桌面或其他支撑。
example.en: Apple-grasp acceptance requires lift-off, persistent support from both pads and exclusion of table or other support.

zh: 合力平衡可能由错误接触共同完成。
en: An equilibrium can be produced by the wrong contacts.

summary.zh: 滑移是接触面之间出现持续切向相对运动。
summary.en: Slip is sustained relative tangential motion between contact surfaces.

body.zh: 物体相对腕部的位移不等于材料点累计滑移，尤其当手和物体共同移动时。
body.en: Object displacement relative to the wrist is not equivalent to material-point slip when hand and object move together.

example.zh: 苹果低滑移实验同时报告物体漂移与接触点切向速度。
example.en: The low-slip apple study reports both object drift and contact-point tangential speed.

zh: 一次 2 mm 位移阈值不能区分滚动、粘着和材料点滑动。
en: A 2 mm displacement threshold cannot distinguish rolling, sticking and material-point slip.

summary.zh: 接触切换是接触对、法向或活动约束在时间上发生建立、丢失或替换。
summary.en: Contact switching is the make, break or replacement of contact pairs, normals or active constraints in time.

body.zh: 接触切换是离散事件，局部梯度、能量与力账在切换两侧可能不连续。
body.en: Contact switching is a discrete event; local gradients, energy and force ledgers may be discontinuous across it.

example.zh: 面包从浅夹持滚出时，接触身份变化比末态位置更能定位首次失效。
example.en: When bread rolls out of a shallow grasp, changing contact identity locates the first failure better than the terminal pose.

zh: 平滑接触模型不自动消除接触集合切换。
en: A smooth contact model does not remove switches in the contact set.

summary.zh: 软约束允许有限的几何误差，通过带刚度、阻尼和阻抗的响应来纠正。
summary.en: A soft constraint tolerates finite geometric error and responds with stiffness, damping and impedance.

body.zh: 在 MuJoCo 里，`solref` 决定约束想让物体怎么恢复，`solimp` 决定当前误差下这条约束介入多强。比如同一个球落到桌面，前者影响压入后的恢复和回弹，后者可以让刚接触时较柔、压深后变硬。
body.en: In MuJoCo, `solref` sets the target recovery response and `solimp` sets how strongly the constraint acts at the current error. When a ball lands on a table, the former shapes recovery and rebound, while the latter can make the initial contact soft and the deeper response firmer.

example.zh: 对于已建立的接触，固定步长、阻抗和阻尼比，只缩短正格式 `solref` 的时间常数，再比较峰值压入和稳定时间。
example.en: For an established contact, hold the timestep, impedance and damping ratio fixed. Shorten only the positive-format `solref` time constant and compare peak penetration and settling time.

zh: 求解器残差小表示当前数值问题求得较准。材料真实性要靠有单位、有条件的测量来验证。
en: A small solver residual indicates accuracy for the specified numerical problem. Material realism requires measurements with declared units and conditions.

summary.zh: 力是改变线动量的作用，按作用点、方向和时间定义。
summary.en: Force changes linear momentum and is defined by point, direction and time.

body.zh: 控制命令、执行器输出、接触力和广义关节力处在不同接口。
body.en: Control commands, actuator outputs, contact forces and generalized joint forces are different interfaces.

example.zh: 力限幅为 10 N 不等于每个接触都实际承受 10 N。
example.en: A 10 N force limit does not mean every contact actually carries 10 N.

zh: 命令力、饱和前力和关节侧合力不能混读。
en: Commanded force, pre-clamp force and joint-side net force are not interchangeable.

summary.zh: 力矩是力相对某点产生的转动作用。
summary.en: Torque is the rotational effect of a force about a point.

body.zh: 接触力矩需要接触点力臂、法向、切向和内禀扭转一起计算。
body.en: Contact torque requires force arm, normal, tangential and intrinsic torsional components.

example.zh: Wuji 点接触可以维持位置，却缺少阻止球绕夹持线转动的力矩方向。
example.en: A Wuji point contact can hold position while lacking the torque direction needed to stop rotation about the grasp line.

zh: 线动量残差为零不能覆盖角动量残差。
en: A zero linear-momentum residual does not cover angular-momentum residuals.

summary.zh: 冲量是力在一段时间上的积分，直接对应动量变化。
summary.en: Impulse integrates force over an interval and directly corresponds to momentum change.

body.zh: 瞬时峰值力和有限步长内的冲量不能互换。
body.en: Peak instantaneous force and integrated impulse over a finite step are not interchangeable.

example.zh: 切割评分检查刀面净冲量，而不只检查某一帧的接触力。
example.en: Cutting scores check net blade impulse rather than only contact force at one frame.

zh: 峰值更高不代表总动量交换更大。
en: A higher peak does not imply a larger net momentum exchange.

summary.zh: 质量描述物体对线加速度的惯性以及重力的比例。
summary.en: Mass sets resistance to linear acceleration and scales gravitational force.

body.zh: 仿真物体质量是模型参数，包含网格、装配或内部部件的等效方式必须说明。
body.en: Simulation mass is a model parameter; its mesh, assembly or internal-component equivalent must be stated.

example.zh: 质量补偿改变后，同一接触刚度夹具可恢复目标响应。
example.en: With mass compensation, the same contact-stiffness fixture recovers its target response.

zh: 几何体积相同不代表质量或惯量相同。
en: Equal volume does not imply equal mass or inertia.

summary.zh: 惯量描述物体或多体系统对加速度的阻力。
summary.en: Inertia describes resistance to acceleration for a body or multibody system.

body.zh: 闭链、gear 与执行器阻尼会改变控制端看到的有效惯量。
body.en: Closed chains, gears and actuator damping can change the effective inertia seen at the control interface.

example.zh: 脚踝输出关节自身惯量小，抗扭主要来自闭链另一侧的电机。
example.en: The ankle output joint has little inertia of its own; most resistance comes from motors across the closed chain.

zh: 惯量不是只有体质量；还包含质心、方向与 armature。
en: Inertia is more than body mass; COM, orientation and armature also matter.

summary.zh: Armature 是把齿轮或电机转子惯量折合到关节后的附加惯量。
summary.en: Armature is joint-space inertia reflecting motor or geared rotor inertia.

body.zh: 它对轻量手指和脚踝的稳定性尤其重要，可改善条件数并减少速度突变。
body.en: It is especially important for light fingers and ankles, improving conditioning and reducing velocity jumps.

example.zh: 力饱和时缺 armature 的小惯量 link 一步可获得很大的速度变化。
example.en: Without armature, a low-inertia link can gain a large velocity change in one saturated-force step.

zh: armature 不是阻尼，增加它主要改变质量矩阵。
en: Armature is not damping; it primarily changes the mass matrix.

summary.zh: 刚度描述位移偏离目标时恢复力增长的快慢。
summary.en: Stiffness describes how quickly restoring force grows with displacement.

body.zh: 高刚度提高跟踪和穿透抑制，也可能放大时间离散、饱和和接触不稳定。
body.en: Higher stiffness can improve tracking and penetration suppression while amplifying time discretization, saturation and contact instability.

example.zh: 同一串行增益映射到闭链电机后可能产生不同的脚踝等效刚度。
example.en: The same serial gain mapped to closed-chain motors can produce different effective ankle stiffness.

zh: 接触刚度、执行器刚度和材料杨氏模量不是同一参数。
en: Contact stiffness, actuator stiffness and Young's modulus are not the same parameter.

summary.zh: 阻尼产生与速度相反、通常耗散能量的一般化力。
summary.en: Damping produces a generalized force opposing velocity and normally dissipates energy.

body.zh: 阻尼可改善稳定性，但过强会让接触、跟踪和控制响应显得粘滞或迟钝。
body.en: Damping can improve stability, while excessive damping makes contact, tracking and control responses sluggish.

example.zh: 执行器出力饱和时，饱和平台可能不再提供原有隐含阻尼。
example.en: Once an actuator saturates, the clamped force may stop contributing its previous implicit damping.

zh: 数值阻尼不等于真实材料阻尼，也不一定写进能量账的同一项。
en: Numerical damping is not real material damping and may not enter the energy ledger in the same term.

summary.zh: 人工阻尼不是材料指定阻尼，而是由积分、投影、截断或稳定化引入的额外耗散。
summary.en: Artificial damping is extra dissipation introduced by integration, projection, truncation or stabilization rather than a declared material.

body.zh: 它能让结果稳定，却可能压低理想运动、改变接触冲量并掩盖能量问题。
body.en: It can stabilize results while suppressing intended motion, changing contact impulses and hiding energy problems.

example.zh: 方向截断若连切向运动也限制，会产生非材料来源的阻尼。
example.en: If truncation also restricts tangential motion, it introduces damping with no material origin.

zh: 画面更平滑不是物理更准确；必须检查驱动功与耗散账。
en: Smoother video is not greater physical accuracy; check drive work and dissipation ledgers.

summary.zh: 线动量等于质量乘质心速度。
summary.en: Linear momentum equals mass times center-of-mass velocity.

body.zh: 逐步动量残差用于检查接触、重力与外力冲量是否在同一时间窗闭合。
body.en: Stepwise momentum residuals check whether contact, gravity and external impulses close over the same time window.

example.zh: Genesis 布料耦合在第 56 步先改变布动量，板到第 57 步才收到相反变化。
example.en: In Genesis cloth coupling, cloth momentum changes at step 56 while the plate receives the opposite change at step 57.

zh: 末态抵消不能消除中间一步的动量失败。
en: Cancellation at the endpoint does not erase a one-step transient momentum failure.

summary.zh: 角动量描述转动惯性乘以角速度，并包含接触点力臂贡献。
summary.en: Angular momentum combines rotational inertia and angular velocity, including contact-force moments.

body.zh: 角动量检查不能由线动量检查替代。
body.en: An angular-momentum check cannot be replaced by a linear-momentum check.

example.zh: 球可能在位置几乎不漂移时仍持续绕夹持线转动。
example.en: A ball can keep rotating about the grasp line while its position barely drifts.

zh: 角速度不是角动量；惯量矩阵会改变两者关系。
en: Angular velocity is not angular momentum; inertia changes the relation.

summary.zh: 动能是物体由于平动和转动速度而具有的能量。
summary.en: Kinetic energy is energy associated with translational and rotational velocity.

body.zh: 在多体系统中应按实际质量矩阵与全部速度计算，而不是只加质心平动项。
body.en: For multibody systems, compute it from the actual mass matrix and all velocities, not only COM translation.

example.zh: 异常逃逸时只给物体势能变化会漏掉机器人连杆动能。
example.en: Reporting only object potential change during an escape misses robot-link kinetic energy.

zh: 速度峰值不能直接替代动能预算。
en: Peak speed cannot replace an energy budget.

summary.zh: 势能是与保守力位形相关的能量。
summary.en: Potential energy is energy associated with the configuration of conservative forces.

body.zh: 重力势能下降可能同时进入平动、转动、接触和耗散项。
body.en: A drop in gravitational potential can feed translation, rotation, contact and dissipation.

example.zh: 面包掉落时约 62.4 mJ 势能下降不能自动全归为额外平动动能。
example.en: A roughly 62.4 mJ potential drop during bread loss cannot automatically be assigned to extra translational kinetic energy.

zh: 高度差只给出势能变化的一部分，除非质量与参考面明确。
en: A height difference gives potential change only with known mass and reference surface.

summary.zh: 功是力或力矩沿位移或角位移累积的能量传递。
summary.en: Work is energy transfer accumulated from force or torque along displacement.

body.zh: 主动执行器本身是能量源，不能把机器人所有异常速度都归给被动 solver。
body.en: An active actuator is itself an energy source; not every anomalous speed belongs to the passive solver.

example.zh: 卡滞后继续深压时，驱动功、重力功和接触冲量要进入同一本账。
example.en: After a jam, continued pressing requires drive work, gravity work and contact impulse in one ledger.

zh: 末端速度大不等于 solver 注入了全部能量。
en: High terminal speed does not prove the solver injected all energy.

summary.zh: 能量交换是驱动、重力、接触、阻尼和数值投影之间发生的能量转移。
summary.en: Energy exchange is the transfer among actuation, gravity, contact, damping and numerical projection.

body.zh: 含执行器与接触的系统不能假定机械能守恒，而应核对输入功、势能、动能和耗散。
body.en: A system with actuators and contact need not conserve total mechanical energy; check input work, potential, kinetic and dissipation.

example.zh: 非穿模投影通过几何安全时，仍要检查它是否额外耗散或注入了能量。
example.en: A non-penetration projection can pass geometry checks while still adding or removing energy.

zh: 动量平衡不是能量守恒；二者必须分别验收。
en: Momentum balance is not energy conservation; validate them separately.

summary.zh: 恢复系数描述碰撞后法向分离速度相对碰撞前接近速度的比例。
summary.en: Restitution scales post-impact separation speed against pre-impact approach speed.

body.zh: 软接触的有限持续过程不总能用一个瞬时恢复系数完全描述。
body.en: A finite soft-contact process may not be fully represented by one instantaneous restitution coefficient.

example.zh: 弹性碰撞评测把恢复系数作为解析参照，同时另报穿透和能量误差。
example.en: Elastic-impact evaluation uses restitution as an analytic reference while reporting penetration and energy error separately.

zh: 材料 restitution 不是接触弹簧阻尼比。
en: Material restitution is not the contact spring damping ratio.

summary.zh: 积分器规定如何从当前状态计算下一时刻的位置与速度。
summary.en: An integrator specifies how the next position and velocity are computed from the current state.

body.zh: Euler、implicitfast、implicit 和 discrete 对阻尼、刚度与约束使用不同的有效系统。
body.en: Euler, implicitfast, implicit and discrete use different effective systems for damping, stiffness and constraints.

example.zh: G1 闭链脚踝中，`implicitfast` 与约束求解的有效惯量不一致，而 `discrete` 使用了同一系统。
example.en: In the G1 closed-chain ankle, implicitfast and the constraint solve use inconsistent effective inertia, while discrete shares one system.

zh: 积分器名称不能单独证明梯度、能量或接触行为。
en: An integrator name does not alone determine gradients, energy or contact behavior.

summary.zh: Euler 积分用当前或新速度推进状态，计算简单但对刚度和高速接触更敏感。
summary.en: Euler integration advances state with current or new velocity and is sensitive to stiff or fast contact.

body.zh: MuJoCo 的默认 Euler 会隐式处理关节阻尼，但这不等于所有阻尼都隐式。
body.en: MuJoCo's default Euler handles joint damping implicitly, but that does not make every damping term implicit.

example.zh: 同一步长下 Euler 与 discrete 的稳定范围可能完全不同。
example.en: Euler and discrete can have completely different stability ranges at the same timestep.

zh: Euler 不是“没有阻尼处理”的同义词。
en: Euler is not synonymous with no damping treatment.

summary.zh: 半隐式方法先更新速度，再用新速度更新位置。
summary.en: A semi-implicit method updates velocity first and then position with the new velocity.

body.zh: 半隐式不等于一次隐式求解，也不等于完整隐式位置更新。
body.en: Semi-implicit is not one implicit solve and not fully implicit position update.

example.zh: 课程中的“旧旧 / 新旧”用于说明更新顺序，不能替代引擎源码核查。
example.en: Old-old and old-new labels teach update order but do not replace source inspection.

zh: Semi-implicit 是一个方法家族，具体实现可能处理不同力项。
en: Semi-implicit is a family; implementations may treat different force terms differently.

summary.zh: `implicitfast` 隐式处理部分速度相关力，并省略较昂贵的科氏与离心导数。
summary.en: implicitfast integrates selected velocity-dependent forces implicitly while omitting costly Coriolis and centrifugal derivatives.

body.zh: 它的计算成本接近 Euler，但稳定性和有效惯量语义不同；闭链约束仍需看求解器使用哪个系统。
body.en: Its cost is close to Euler, but stability and effective-inertia semantics differ; closed-chain constraints still need metric inspection.

example.zh: 脚踝位置执行器在 4 ms 下使用 implicitfast 可使闭链误差增长。
example.en: Ankle position actuators with implicitfast at 4 ms can make closed-chain error grow.

zh: 名字里有 implicit 不代表所有约束与位置刚度都隐式。
en: The name implicit does not make all constraints and position stiffness implicit.

summary.zh: MuJoCo `discrete` 把约束求解和隐式速度更新放进同一有效惯量度量。
summary.en: MuJoCo discrete combines constraint solving and implicit velocity updates in one effective-inertia metric.

body.zh: 它把阻尼与正位置刚度纳入 `M + hD + h²K`，其 `qacc` 表示一步速度差分。
body.en: It includes damping and positive position stiffness in M + hD + h²K, and qacc represents a one-step velocity difference.

example.zh: G1 脚踝在位置执行器加闭链时用 discrete 保持稳定。
example.en: The G1 ankle remained stable with discrete when position actuators drove the closed chain.

zh: 稳定不是能量守恒或所有模型的普适正确性证明。
en: Stability is not a proof of energy conservation or universal correctness.

summary.zh: 活动集是当前进入求解的有效约束集合。
summary.en: The active set is the collection of constraints currently included in the solve.

body.zh: 接触建立、限位触发或力饱和会改变活动集，使力和加速度出现分段变化。
body.en: Contact make/break, limits or force saturation can change the active set and make force or acceleration piecewise.

example.zh: 限位附近的“力矩不连续”可能来自活动约束切换，而不是 FP32 错误。
example.en: A torque kink near a limit can come from active-constraint switching rather than an FP32 bug.

zh: 活动集变化不是普通数值噪声，不能靠平滑画线消除。
en: Active-set changes are not ordinary noise and cannot be removed by smoothing a plot.

summary.zh: 残差衡量当前数值结果偏离方程或记录一致性的程度。
summary.en: A residual measures how far a numerical result departs from its governing equations or record identity.

body.zh: 不同残差有不同单位与时刻，不能混成一个总误差。
body.en: Residuals have different units and epochs and cannot be collapsed into one score.

example.zh: 动量残差、接触力账残差和闭链杆长残差回答不同问题。
example.en: Momentum residuals, contact-force ledger residuals and rod-length residuals answer different questions.

zh: 低残差不证明模型接近真实材料。
en: A low residual does not prove a model matches real material.

summary.zh: 容差定义求解器何时认为残差已足够小。
summary.en: Tolerance defines when a solver considers its residual sufficiently small.

body.zh: 收紧容差可能改善局部解，却不消除模型误差或步长敏感性。
body.en: Tighter tolerance may improve a local solve without removing model error or timestep sensitivity.

example.zh: SuperDex 容差收紧 100/10,000 倍后，跨步长位置差仍约 3.206 mm。
example.en: After tightening SuperDex tolerances by 100 and 10,000 times, cross-timestep position difference remained about 3.206 mm.

zh: 到达容差不是到达高精度真值。
en: Hitting tolerance does not imply hitting a high-accuracy truth.

summary.zh: 迭代是求解器逐步减小残差或更新约束变量的过程。
summary.en: An iteration progressively reduces residual or updates constraint variables.

body.zh: 更多迭代可以提供更多求解预算，但不修复错误几何、错误控制或不等价接触模型。
body.en: More iterations buy more solve budget but do not repair wrong geometry, control or inequivalent contact models.

example.zh: SuperDex 从 100 提到 400 次迭代仍未消除某个边缘接触失败。
example.en: Raising SuperDex from 100 to 400 iterations did not remove one edge-contact failure.

zh: 迭代上限不是实际执行次数，AUTO 也不是运行分支遥测。
en: Iteration cap is not executed count, and AUTO is not runtime branch telemetry.

summary.zh: 有效惯量把质量、阻尼、刚度、传动或执行器反馈合并为当前步更新使用的系统。
summary.en: Effective inertia combines mass, damping, stiffness, transmission or actuator feedback for the current update.

body.zh: 如果动力学更新与约束求解使用不同有效系统，强阻尼和小输出惯量会放大不一致。
body.en: If dynamics update and constraint solve use different effective systems, strong damping and small output inertia amplify mismatch.

example.zh: 闭链脚踝的 implicitfast 不一致正是通过有效惯量解释。
example.en: The implicitfast inconsistency in the closed-chain ankle is explained by effective inertia.

zh: 有效惯量不是简单读取单个 body 的质量。
en: Effective inertia is not simply one body's mass.

summary.zh: 质量矩阵把加速度映射为广义惯性力，并编码关节耦合。
summary.en: The mass matrix maps acceleration to generalized inertial force and encodes joint coupling.

body.zh: 接触求解、逆动力学和有效惯量都依赖其条件数与耦合结构。
body.en: Contact solving, inverse dynamics and effective inertia all depend on its conditioning and coupling.

example.zh: 闭链另一侧电机通过约束改变输出关节的有效质量矩阵。
example.en: Motors across the closed chain alter the output joint's effective mass matrix through constraints.

zh: 质量矩阵不是多个物体质量的对角列表。
en: The mass matrix is not a diagonal list of body masses.

summary.zh: 精度描述状态、参数和运算使用的浮点表示。
summary.en: Precision describes the floating-point representation of state, parameters and operations.

body.zh: FP32 可能影响小量、长时间和病态问题，但不能从一次穿模直接推断精度是根因。
body.en: FP32 can affect small quantities, long runs and ill-conditioned problems, but one penetration does not identify precision as the cause.

example.zh: 相同默认接触参数下，MuJoCo 与 MJWarp 的最大侵入只相差约 0.000151 mm。
example.en: With identical default contact parameters, MuJoCo and MJWarp maximum intrusions differed by only about 0.000151 mm.

zh: 引擎、接触参数和精度应分开归因。
en: Attribute engine, contact parameters and precision separately.

summary.zh: 连续碰撞检测在一步运动扫掠中寻找可能发生的首次碰撞。
summary.en: Continuous collision detection searches for first impact along motion within a step.

body.zh: CCD 主要处理薄物体或高速运动漏碰，不是静态卡滞或错误接触律的通用修复。
body.en: CCD targets missed collisions of thin or fast objects, not generic static jams or wrong contact laws.

example.zh: RoboDojo 卡滞案例把 CCD 与迭代、去穿透速度和步长分别测试。
example.en: The RoboDojo jam case tests CCD separately from iterations, depenetration speed and timestep.

zh: 开启 CCD 不等于保证任意模型、任意步长不穿透。
en: Enabling CCD does not guarantee non-penetration for every model or timestep.

summary.zh: 预测接触在表面尚未真正重叠时加入可能的一步内接触约束。
summary.en: Speculative contact adds a possible within-step constraint before surfaces actually overlap.

body.zh: 它可防止高速薄物体穿越，但响应强度和适用范围必须逐模型验证。
body.en: It can prevent fast thin objects from tunneling, while response strength and supported geometry require model-specific checks.

example.zh: MuJoCo 4 的预测接触能力不等于所有网格、所有接触模式都被覆盖。
example.en: MuJoCo 4 speculative contact does not cover every mesh and contact mode.

zh: 预测接触不是连续时间的完整非穿透证明。
en: Speculative contact is not a complete continuous-time non-penetration proof.

summary.zh: 原生读回是从实际运行引擎取得的配置、状态、接触或力字段。
summary.en: Native readback is runtime data obtained from the actual engine configuration, state, contact or forces.

body.zh: 配置文件名、命令参数和日志声称不能代替实际有效参数。
body.en: Configuration files, command arguments and claimed settings cannot replace effective runtime values.

example.zh: 记录 MuJoCo 的编译后 timestep、integrator 和解算器，而不是只保存源 XML。
example.en: Record compiled MuJoCo timestep, integrator and solver rather than only storing source XML.

zh: AUTO、默认值与请求值不是运行时生效值。
en: AUTO, defaults and requested values are not effective runtime values.

summary.zh: 数值一致性检查记录中的力、速度、冲量和状态是否在同一模型与时刻下互相吻合。
summary.en: Numerical consistency checks whether recorded forces, velocities, impulses and states agree under the same model and epochs.

body.zh: 它排除记录错误、符号错误和时间错位，不证明真实材料准确。
body.en: It rules out record, sign and epoch errors; it does not prove real-material accuracy.

example.zh: 动量残差和接触力求和属于这一层，而画面不参与通过。
example.en: Momentum residuals and contact-force sums belong to this layer; video does not decide acceptance.

zh: 一致性通过不是物理正确性通过。

summary.zh: 收敛指随步长或求解预算变细，结果趋于稳定且残差减小。
summary.en: Convergence means results stabilize and residuals shrink as timestep or solve budget refines.

body.zh: 必须用多档步长和误差曲线证明，不能因两个相邻点接近就宣称收敛。
body.en: Demonstrate it over a refinement grid and error curve; agreement at two adjacent settings is insufficient.

example.zh: 接触响应空间细化最初并非单调，最后才出现稳定改善。
example.en: Spatial refinement of contact response was initially non-monotonic before a stable improvement appeared.

zh: 求解器达到容差与整个模型时间收敛不是同一结论。
en: Solver tolerance convergence and whole-model temporal convergence are different claims.

summary.zh: 敏感性描述输出对步长、参数、几何或求解预算变化的响应幅度。
summary.en: Sensitivity measures how strongly an output responds to changes in timestep, parameters, geometry or budget.

body.zh: 敏感性结果可以是非单调的，也可随另一参数变化改变方向。
body.en: Sensitivity can be non-monotonic and can reverse under another parameter.

example.zh: 六卡接触诊断中 0.5 ms 的最大侵入可大于 2 ms。
example.en: In the six-device contact diagnostic, 0.5 ms could produce larger maximum intrusion than 2 ms.

zh: 敏感不等于不收敛，不敏感也不等于准确。
en: Sensitive does not mean nonconvergent, and insensitive does not mean accurate.

summary.zh: 正对照应通过，负对照应在关闭或替换被检验条件后被拒绝。
summary.en: The positive control should pass and the negative should be rejected when the tested condition is disabled or replaced.

body.zh: 负例意外通过会让整项证据无效，说明评分器仍有捷径。
body.en: A negative control that unexpectedly passes invalidates the evidence because the scorer still admits a shortcut.

example.zh: 张指、禁接触和零摩擦应阻止物体被手支撑。
example.en: Open fingers, disabled contact and zero friction should prevent hand support.

zh: 正例数量不能弥补缺失的负例。
en: More positive cases do not replace missing negatives.

summary.zh: 留出集是不用于调参的评价条件。
summary.en: A held-out set contains evaluation conditions not used for tuning.

body.zh: 如果留出结果被回灌调参，它就变成开发集。
body.en: Once held-out outcomes feed tuning, the data become development data.

example.zh: 冻结目标后的十个苹果场景与布料留出配置分别评价。
example.en: Ten frozen apple scenarios and cloth held-out profiles are evaluated without post hoc retuning.

zh: 留出集通过不是随机总体成功率。
en: Passing a held-out set is not a random-population success probability.

summary.zh: 任务成功是任务定义的最终状态和过程条件全部满足。
summary.en: Task success means all defined final-state and process conditions are met.

body.zh: 任务完成、物理有效性和记录有效性是不同维度。
body.en: Task completion, physical validity and record validity are separate dimensions.

example.zh: 物体到达目标并不证明持续摩擦支撑或无穿透。
example.en: An object reaching its target does not prove persistent friction support or non-penetration.

zh: 运行退出 0 和视频生成都不是物理成功。
en: Exit code 0 and video generation are not physical success.

summary.zh: 证据边界说明结论覆盖的模型、配置、条件、指标与分母。
summary.en: An evidence boundary states the covered model, configuration, conditions, metrics and denominator.

body.zh: 没有边界的数字会被误读成通用性能或真实世界精度。
body.en: Numbers without boundaries are easily misread as general performance or real-world accuracy.

example.zh: MuJoCo 1/10 和 SuperDex 10/10 只说明两个冻结配置的该任务结果。
example.en: MuJoCo 1/10 and SuperDex 10/10 describe only those two frozen configurations on that task.

zh: 补一句“非排名”不能替代保留失败和条件。
en: Adding a disclaimer does not replace retaining failures and conditions.

summary.zh: 执行器饱和是控制律要求的输出超过执行器或关节允许的力或力矩上限。
summary.en: Actuator saturation occurs when the controller requests more force or torque than the actuator or joint permits.

body.zh: 饱和输出是平台而不是线性增益；位置执行器在饱和时可能失去原有的速度反馈阻尼。
body.en: A saturated output is a plateau rather than a linear gain; a position actuator may lose its previous velocity-feedback damping while clamped.

example.zh: 小惯量关节在力上限和较大步长下，一步速度变化可近似达到 hF/M。
example.en: For a low-inertia joint, one step can approach hF/M velocity change under a force cap and a large timestep.

zh: 命令值、限幅前执行器力和关节侧实际合力不是同一个读数。
en: Command, pre-clamp actuator force and actual joint-side net force are different readings.

summary.zh: 接触力是接触模型在当前求解时刻通过接触点交换的力。
summary.en: Contact force is the force exchanged at contact points by the contact model at the current solve epoch.

body.zh: 逐接触记录还要保留标识、位置、法向、时间窗和符号约定。
body.en: Per-contact records also need identity, position, normal, time window and sign convention.

example.zh: 采样间隔内十个物理子步的峰值法向力，不能直接代表整个 40 ms 的平均接触力。
example.en: The peak normal force within ten physics substeps does not represent the average contact force over the full 40 ms sample.

zh: 接触数大于零不等于力方向正确或目标表面承担负载。
en: A positive contact count does not establish correct direction or that the intended surface carries the load.

summary.zh: 重力是质量在引力场中受到的一般化外力。
summary.en: Gravity is the generalized external force of a mass in a gravitational field.

body.zh: 自由落体和支撑检查需要与模型实际重力、单位和时钟一致。
body.en: Free-fall and support checks require the model’s effective gravity, units and clock.

example.zh: 无地板负例应保留重力驱动自由落体，而不是把缺失支撑改写成零摩擦。
example.en: A no-floor negative should retain gravity-driven free fall rather than relabel missing support as zero friction.

zh: 重力补偿力不是重力本身，也不是接触支撑力。
en: Gravity compensation is neither gravity nor contact support.

summary.zh: 碰撞过滤决定哪些几何对可以产生接触。
summary.en: Collision filtering determines which geometry pairs may generate contacts.

body.zh: 父子体排除、碰撞层、显式 pair 和导入器推断必须分开保存。
body.en: Parent-child exclusions, collision layers, explicit pairs and importer inference must be retained separately.

example.zh: MJCF 导入 PhysX 时，源模型隐式父子排除被展开为 267 对原生读回。
example.en: Importing an MJCF scene into PhysX materialized 267 native exclusion pairs, including implied parent-child exclusions.

zh: 转换后没有缺对不等于所有过滤语义均可双向读取。
en: No missing pairs after conversion does not mean every filter semantic can be read in both directions.

summary.zh: 柔顺描述约束或接触在力作用下的可变形程度。
summary.en: Compliance describes how readily a constraint or contact deforms under load.

body.zh: 柔顺介于忽略小重叠与冻结穿透之间，需要与载荷、几何尺度和时间常数一起解释。
body.en: Compliance sits between ignoring overlap and freezing penetration; interpret it with load, geometry scale and time constant.

example.zh: MuJoCo 软接触可进入毫米级重叠而保持有限力，不能因此把原生接触深度当作独立表面误差。
example.en: MuJoCo soft contact can enter millimetre overlap with finite force; native contact depth is not therefore an independent surface error.

zh: 柔顺参数不是已标定的真实材料刚度。
en: A compliance parameter is not a calibrated real-material stiffness.

summary.zh: 接触时间常数决定软约束恢复速度，并受步长稳定性下限影响。
summary.en: Contact time constant sets soft-constraint recovery speed and interacts with a timestep stability floor.

body.zh: 读回的正数 timeconst 不一定等于运行时有效值；refsafe 可能按步长替换或提高。
body.en: A stored positive time constant is not always the effective runtime value; refsafe may replace or raise it with timestep.

example.zh: 六卡接触诊断中，增大接触时间常数会让相同步长的侵入明显恶化。
example.en: In the six-device contact diagnostic, a larger contact time constant made intrusion much worse at the same timestep.

zh: 时间常数缩短不证明接触模型更真实，只改变数值响应速度。
en: A shorter time constant does not prove greater material realism; it changes numerical response speed.

summary.zh: 求解状态报告原生算法为何停止或返回当前结果。
summary.en: Solver status reports why a native algorithm stopped or returned its current result.

body.zh: 达到迭代上限、满足停止阈值和找到物理解不是同一结论。
body.en: Hitting an iteration cap, meeting a stopping threshold and finding a physical solution are different claims.

example.zh: SuperDex 零摩擦记录在 STOPPED 状态下出现超限动量残差。
example.en: A SuperDex frictionless record reached STOPPED with a momentum residual beyond the frozen limit.

zh: API 正常返回不等于数值收敛或任务有效。
en: A normal API return does not imply numerical convergence or a valid task result.
